_README: Profiles for the eight SIMULATED nodes (03-10) of the 10-node hybrid CPS
network. JSON, not YAML, deliberately: docs/11 records dropping pyyaml from
this project's dependency list, and pyyaml is not installed. Adding a
dependency to hold eight dictionaries would be exactly the kind of
convenience the project already decided against.
WHAT THESE ARE. Each profile perturbs statistics MEASURED from the real
hardware, in documented directions, with its own frozen seed. They are not
duplicates of real telemetry, and they are not real telemetry with noise
added on top -- each is an independent draw from a generator whose
parameters are offsets from the measured real ones.
WHAT THEY ARE NOT. They are not physical devices, they are never described
as such, and every record they produce carries source_type = SIMULATED.
Their role is controlled network-scale relational context for the
coordinated/distributed anomaly experiments -- not physical evidence.
MEASURED REFERENCE (TRAIN-split real at-rest rows only, n=103, from
sessions 20260902_171313 and 20260902_102448; the VALIDATION and TEST
sessions are NOT consulted, or the simulator would be parameterised from
data it is later evaluated against):
crest_factor   mean 0.0190  sd 0.0130
kurtosis       mean -0.0588 sd 1.0812
dominant_freq  mean 82.22   sd 58.75    (nominal-rate bin index, not Hz)
rms lag-1 autocorrelation 0.5874
Deliberately NOT done: no profile was given an extreme parameter to make
the GNN look better. The variation spans a plausible range around the
measured device and stops there. Nodes 08 and 09 are HARDER than the real
node, not easier.

sw420_note: No SW-420 telemetry has been captured yet. The two simulated switch nodes
are parameterised from the SENSOR's documented behaviour (contact closure
duration, comparator threshold) rather than from measurement, and are
marked accordingly. Once esp32-vib-002 sessions exist, re-derive these two

nodes.variation: Quiet, well-mounted machine. Baseline slightly below the real device, tightest spread of the eight.
Higher DC baseline (different mounting angle changes the gravity projection) and moderately noisier.
Loose mount: much noisier, heavy timing jitter, fatter kurtosis tail. The noisiest normal node.
Slow thermal drift: baseline wanders across the session rather than staying stationary. Tests whether the normal region tolerates drift.
SW-420-like. Sensitive threshold: fires often even at rest, so its resting duty cycle is non-zero.
HARD CASE. Anomalies at 35% of the real node's magnitude -- close to the noise floor. Included precisely because it lowers the reported detection rate.
Slow-developing fault: anomalies are long and recover slowly, more like bearing wear than an impact. Sequence-shaped, so it is the case the LSTM-AE should be best at.
SW-420-like. Conservative threshold: silent at rest, fires only on real disturbance. The opposite configuration to node 07.
